system.description:
The Ravnos overlays false auras and false surface thoughts onto her Chimerstry illusions, so that even supernatural scrutiny is deceived alongside mundane senses.

System: This applies automatically to any use of Chimerstry. If an Auspex (Aura Perception/Telepathy) or Dementation (Eyes of Chaos) roll directed at the illusion or its creator scores five or fewer successes, the prying power detects only mundane, matching thoughts and a simple, unremarkable aura or emotional resonance — never anything that would betray the illusion.

MET: Elder Discipline. Whenever another character attempts to use Aura Perception, Telepathy, or a similar reading power against the Ravnos or her Chimerstry illusion, the Ravnos automatically contests it with a Mental Challenge (bidding her Mental Traits); if the Ravnos wins, the prying character receives only false, simple information, and any attempt to delve deeper reveals nothing beyond a plausible surface impression.
